{{Quote|Es'Loma screamed and fell over the edge of the platform. We ran to see what was going on, and they hit us from behind. They took the box, and killed the Jedi.|Wojarra, recounting the Believer ambush|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Wojarra''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Wojarra joined the crew of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was to ferry a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] to the world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on behalf of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. On arrival on Coruscant, Wojarra and his fellow crew members were ambushed by a group of [[Believers|Believer]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping [[Sith cult|cultists]] who [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the Wookiee and stole the box.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They were all Human, and wore black. There was too much blaster fire to see anything else.|Wojarra, recounting the Believer ambush|<ref name="CD" />}}
Wojarra was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] researchers discovered the [[Pulas]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] decided to transport the relic to the world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for safekeeping and assembled a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to accompany the artifact, with one vessel to carry a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box containing the Pulas and the remaining transporting decoy boxes. Wojarra joined the company of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the armada, alongside the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CD" /> [[Force Adept]]s<ref name="TRW">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: The Resistance Within}}</ref> [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]], and the [[Tarasin]] female [[Es'Loma]]. Wojarra and his fellow crew collected their assigned Mandalorian iron box, containing a fragment of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-imbued [[City/Legends|city]] [[Conkesta]], from the [[Almas Academy]] [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] [[Jedi academy|institution]] and then departed for Coruscant.<ref name="CD" />

On arrival on Coruscant, Wojarra's ship docked on a [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] and the crew were greeted by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nysis Belzara]], who had been sent by the Jedi to accompany them and their box to a safe house. Unknown to Wojarra, his fellow crew member Es'Loma was in league with the [[Believers]], a group of<ref name="CD" /> [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> [[Sith cult|cultists]] who sought to steal the Pulas. Within a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] of arriving on Coruscant, Es'Loma pretended to fall off the side of the landing platform and while Wojarra, Belzara, Herrera and Reston were distracted by her plight, the Believers ambushed them. The [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] shot Belzara and the two [[The Force/Legends|Force]] Adepts and stole the group's Mandalorian iron box. Wojarra succeeded at firing a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracer]] onto the cultists' [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] but was then hit by a [[Stun/Legends|shot]] from a [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun weapon]] and incapacitated.<ref name="CD" />

Following the attack, a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of spacers]] who had been assisting the transportation of another Mandalorian iron box for the Jedi arrived on the landing platform to investigate the ambush. Wojarra provided the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] with an account of the Believers' assault and also gave them a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] from which the tracer he had shot at the cultists' speeder could be tracked. The spacers then departed to pursue the Believers and recover the stolen box.<ref name="CD" />

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
The Jedi-allied spacers subsequently retrieved the Mandalorian iron box from the Believers. As a token of his thanks, Wojarra gifted a [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] weapon to a Wookiee member of the spacer team.<ref name="CD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
When he was ambushed by the Believers on Coruscant, he was displeased by attack and left feeling very grumpy.<ref name="CD" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|I shot their speeder with a tracer. Here. This allows you to track them. Go! Get it back!|Wojarra, to the spacers he encountered following the Believer attack|<ref name="CD" />}}
Wojarra was armed with a bowcaster, a [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile weapon]] commonly used by members of his [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was also equipped with a tracer tracking device and a datapad that could be used to monitor the tracer.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wojarra appeared in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Morrie Mullins]] and set within [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity that formed part of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign and which debuted at the [[Star Wars]] fan convention [[Celebration II]]. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the spacers that Wojarra encounters in the aftermath of the Believer attack. Wojarra provides the player characters information regarding the ambush and either speaks to them directly or with the assistance of a [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]]. The adventure hints that, though Wojarra is innocent of any involvement in planning the Believer ambush, paranoid players might suspect him of collusion with the cultists because he was only stunned during the attack and not critically injured. It is possible for the player characters to take back the stolen box from the Believers and if so, Wojarra bequeaths a bowcaster to any player roleplaying as a Wookiee.<ref name="CD" />
